one_sentence: Cooley & Quadrini (2006), 'Monetary policy and the financial decisions of firms', Economic Theory 27(1):243-270, DOI 10.1007/s00199-004-0553-x -- year/volume/issue/pages/ISSN all verified correct against CrossRef, but the entry is a raw Web-of-Science export with initials-only authors, an ALL-CAPS journal name, a missing DOI, and stray non-BibTeX WoS fields.

issues.corrected: Cooley, Thomas F. and Quadrini, Vincenzo
issues.reason: WoS export gives bare initials. CrossRef metadata for this DOI lists full given names 'Thomas F.' (Thomas Ferguson Cooley) and 'Vincenzo' (Quadrini).
WoS exports journal names in ALL-CAPS; correct title-case rendering per Springer/CrossRef is 'Economic Theory'.

Confirmed correct, not a correction. Checked for online-first vs. issue-year mismatch: manuscript received 2003-11-20, revised 2004-08-26 (the '004' in the DOI suffix s00199-004-0553-x reflects this 2004 processing/acceptance year, not the publication year), but CrossRef's container publication date is January 2006, matching the printed volume/issue. No change needed.

No DOI field present in the WoS export; added the canonical Springer DOI, verified via CrossRef API (api.crossref.org/works/10.1007/s00199-004-0553-x) to resolve to this exact title/author/volume/pages combination.
Not a standard BibTeX field; it is a Web-of-Science internal accession number with no meaning outside WoS. Should be dropped or moved to a 'note'/'annote' field if provenance tracking is desired.

issues.reason: Confirmed correct value against CrossRef (electronic ISSN 1432-0479), but 'EISSN' is not a standard BibTeX field recognized by most styles (only 'issn' is). Kept as supplementary metadata; flagged for hygiene, not accuracy.
Confirmed correct (print ISSN) against CrossRef; no change, listed for completeness of the audit.

Verified via CrossRef that DOI 10.1007/s00199-004-0553-x resolves to exactly title='Monetary policy and the financial decisions of firms', authors Cooley & Quadrini, Economic Theory 27(1):243-270 (2006) -- not to be confused with Cooley & Quadrini's other closely related papers (e.g. 'Financial Markets and Firm Dynamics', AER 2001, 91(5):1286-1310). No mixing detected; all fields belong to the same paper.
